title: Snake
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Snake
learningObjectives: Trace how the snake is stored as an ordered list of grid cells that gains a segment each time food is eaten
Explain how arrow-key input sets a direction vector that the game loop applies on each update tick
Identify the two collision tests that end the game: the snake striking a wall and the snake striking its own body
Predict how raising the speed slider shortens the time between updates and reduces reaction time
Explain why the next direction is buffered rather than applied immediately, preventing an instant reversal into the snake's own neck
